workflow: A formatting operation iterates elements held by a mutable container while invoking user-controlled representation logic.
The callback re-enters the container and removes or clears the element currently being processed.
The original iteration continues using a borrowed reference whose storage was released by the re-entrant mutation.
The stale reference is dereferenced during formatting, causing a use-after-free instead of safely handling the mutation.
summary: Reentrant container mutation invalidates an active element reference
decision_reason: The underlying failure workflow materially matches re-entrant mutation of a container invalidating storage while the original clearing or traversal operation continues using it.
